## How I work

I prefer work with a short path from question to evidence. I build an initial version, instrument it, inspect failures, and decide what to change. Writing is part of that process: it forces me to state what I observed and makes the result reusable.

## The “Enginear” story

When I was ten, a teacher asked what I wanted to become. I said “engineer.” Asked to spell it, I got it wrong, and was told that someone who could not spell the word could not become one.

I kept the misspelling—**Enginear**—as the name of this site.
